from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    """Shift the grid down one row and fill the new top row with the background color."""\n    if not grid:\n        return []\n    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    return [[background for _ in grid[0]]] + [list(row) for row in grid[:-1]]\n'''
p=programs/'task-82599f18.py'
p.write_text(source)
# Demonstration pair as received; verify exact reproduction.
demo_in=[[8,2,2,8,2],[2,8,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,2],[2,8,2,2,2],[8,2,2,2,2],[2,8,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,2],[2,2,2,8,8],[2,2,2,2,8],[2,2,2,2,8],[2,2,8,2,8],[8,2,8,8,2],[8,8,8,2,8]]+[[8]*5 for _ in range(15)]
demo_out=[[8]*5,[8,2,2,8,2],[2,8,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,2],[2,8,2,2,2],[8,2,2,2,2],[2,8,2,2,2],[2,2,2,2,2],[2,2,2,8,8],[2,2,2,2,8],[2,2,2,2,8],[2,2,8,2,8],[8,2,8,8,2],[8,8,8,2,8]]+[[8]*5 for _ in range(15)]
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
print('demo reproduced:',transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
